messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel-tuner rollout this morning I see a clear perf regression for seq=512 workloads on p4d. p95 +120ms compared to canary from yesterday. Profiling shows fallback to the generic matmul path instead of the tuned fused kernel. :eyes:
kevin: Which change in the tuner landed? the autotune keying or the persistence format?
maria: It was the new persistence format that tried to be more 'compact'. We removed explicit arch/driver tagging to dedupe entries across infra, which in hindsight let incompatible kernel picks survive a driver bump. snippet from the persisted key prefix: `model:{id}|quant:{q}|seq_bucket:{b}` — no arch/driver info.
sam: Oof. So the persisted pick for p4d is being reused on g5-like configs (or vice versa) and then the runtime falls back at runtime when the kernel ABI mismatch happens -> slower path.
jess: If we invalidate aggressively we'll spike cold tune runs and increase e2e latency for a while. We need a middle ground: targeted invalidation + soft TTL + rollout-aware pinning.
ryan: Agreed. Proposal: include arch, driver_hash, and runtime_flags in the key. Also add a small sequence-length bucketing change: narrower buckets around 128/256/512 where we saw big perf cliffs. Example key: `arch|model|quant|seq_bucket|driver_hash|runtime_hash`.
kevin: +1. Concrete schema I propose: `kernel_key = f"{arch}|{model_id}|{quant}|{seq_bucket}|drv{driver_version}|rt{runtime_build}"` persist path: `/kvcache/{arch}/{model_id}/{kernel_key}.meta` TTL default 24h. Pin entries for active canaries for 48h. Invalidation triggers: model_version change, runtime major bump, kernel ABI fingerprint mismatch.
maria: Also adding a quick check at load-time: if persisted kernel metadata.claims_supported != runtime.supported_kernels -> force re-autotune. That avoids silent falls to generic path.
sam: For persistence storage, recommend layout that scopes by arch so listing/invalidation is efficient: `/{arch}/...` means we can nuke one arch without touching others.
jess: For rollout smoothing: when we deploy a new driver/runtime, the control plane should mark a rollout window. During the window we: 1) allow fallback for a bit, 2) run background autotune for hot models, 3) avoid mass invalidation until canary success.
ryan: And add a small regression detector (daily canary run): if p95 increases > X ms then invalidate matching keys and trigger immediate re-autotune for the impacted seq buckets.
kevin: Implementation tasks:
- change key format + persistence writer (eng-runtime)  
- arch-scoped storage layout (eng-infra)  
- add load-time compatibility checks (runtime)  
- control-plane rollout flags + pin API (platform)
I'll open PRs for the first two.
liz: Assigning owners: kevin -> persistence/key change, maria -> load-time checks & perf tests, sam -> storage layout, jess -> rollout policy design, ryan -> canary/regression detector. I'll put these on the sprint board. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy event: kernel-tuner v2 rolled to prod at 2026-03-17T11:03:20Z (canaries 5/5).
